name: Strawberry Oat Sorbet
instructions: Blend strawberries, oat milk, maple syrup, and lemon juice until completely smooth.
Pour into the Ninja Creami pint container, filling to the max fill line.
Freeze for exactly 24 hours on a flat surface.
Remove from freezer. Run the pint under warm water for 30 seconds.
Process on the Sorbet setting. Serve immediately.

respinFix.fix: Add 1 tablespoon oat milk and use the Respin setting on the Deluxe.
Let the pint sit at room temperature for 2 minutes before respinning.

name: Banana Vanilla Cream
instructions: Blend banana, milk, yogurt, vanilla, and honey until silky smooth.
Pour into pint container to the max fill line.
Freeze for exactly 24 hours.
Run under warm water for 30 seconds before processing.
Process on the Lite Ice Cream setting.

respinFix.fix: Add 2 tablespoons pasteurized milk and respin.
Drizzle with a small amount of honey before serving.

name: Mango Coconut Sorbet
instructions: Blend mango, coconut milk, lime juice, and maple syrup until completely smooth.
Pour into the pint container to the max fill line.
Freeze for exactly 24 hours.
Remove from freezer, run under warm water for 30 seconds.
Process on the Sorbet setting.

respinFix.fix: Let sit 3 minutes then respin on Sorbet.
Return to freezer for 30 minutes then respin.

name: Peach Ginger Sorbet
instructions: Blend peaches, oat milk, ginger, maple syrup, and lemon juice until fully smooth.
Pour into pint container to the max fill line.
Freeze for exactly 24 hours on a flat surface.
Run under warm water for 30 seconds before processing.
Process on the Sorbet setting.

respinFix.fix: Add 1 tablespoon oat milk and respin on Sorbet.
Drizzle with 1 teaspoon honey and gently fold before serving.

name: Blueberry Yogurt Cream
instructions: Blend blueberries, yogurt, honey, and vanilla until completely smooth.
Pour into pint container to the max fill line.
Freeze for exactly 24 hours.
Run under warm water for 30 seconds before processing.
Process on the Lite Ice Cream setting.

respinFix.fix: Add 1 tablespoon pasteurized milk and respin.
Let rest at room temperature 2 minutes then respin.

name: Oat Date Caramel
instructions: Soak pitted dates in warm water for 10 minutes, then drain.
Blend dates, oat milk, oats, vanilla, and salt until completely smooth.
Pour into pint container to the max fill line.
Freeze for exactly 24 hours.
Run under warm water for 30 seconds, then process on the Lite Ice Cream setting.

respinFix.fix: Add 2 tablespoons oat milk and respin on the Respin setting.
Add 1 tablespoon oat milk and respin.

name: Raspberry Coconut Sorbet
instructions: Blend raspberries, coconut milk, maple syrup, and lemon juice until smooth.
Strain through a fine mesh sieve to remove seeds if desired.
Pour into pint container to the max fill line.
Freeze for exactly 24 hours.
Run under warm water 30 seconds, then process on Sorbet setting.

respinFix.fix: Drizzle 1 teaspoon maple syrup and fold gently before serving.
Add 1 tablespoon coconut milk and respin on Sorbet.

name: Pear Oat Cream
instructions: Blend pears, oat milk, honey, and vanilla until silky smooth.
Pour into pint container to the max fill line.
Freeze for exactly 24 hours.
Run under warm water for 30 seconds.
Process on the Lite Ice Cream setting.

respinFix.fix: Let sit 2 minutes then respin on Lite Ice Cream.
Add 2 tablespoons oat milk and respin.

name: Banana Peanut Butter Cream
instructions: Blend bananas, milk, peanut butter, and honey until completely smooth.
Pour into pint container to the max fill line.
Freeze for exactly 24 hours.
Run under warm water for 30 seconds.
Process on the Ice Cream setting.

respinFix.fix: Add 2 tablespoons pasteurized milk and respin on Ice Cream.
Add 1 tablespoon peanut butter and 1 tablespoon milk, then respin.

name: Watermelon Mint Sorbet
instructions: Blend watermelon, coconut water, mint, lime juice, and maple syrup until smooth.
Pour into pint container to the max fill line.
Freeze for exactly 24 hours.
Run under warm water for 30 seconds.
Process on the Sorbet setting.

respinFix.fix: Return to freezer for 20 minutes and respin on Sorbet.
Let sit 3 minutes at room temperature then respin.

name: Apple Cinnamon Oat
instructions: Blend applesauce, oat milk, cinnamon, maple syrup, and oats until smooth.
Pour into pint container to the max fill line.
Freeze for exactly 24 hours.
Run under warm water for 30 seconds.
Process on the Sorbet setting.

respinFix.fix: Add 1 tablespoon oat milk and respin.
Drizzle 1 teaspoon maple syrup and fold before serving.

name: Coconut Mango Lime Cream
instructions: Blend mango, coconut milk, coconut yogurt, lime juice, and maple syrup until silky.
Pour into pint container to the max fill line.
Freeze for exactly 24 hours.
Run under warm water for 30 seconds.
Process on the Lite Ice Cream setting.

respinFix.fix: Add 2 tablespoons light coconut milk and respin.
Let sit 2 minutes then respin on Lite Ice Cream.
